name: sixnine
source:
An open-world game featuring quests and sex scenes. 
You can explore the map, take on quests and hidden quests, and search for hidden scenes within the map. You’ll play as the main character in the year 3000, when humanity is on the brink of extinction. You must impregnate several NPCs to have children and ensure humanity’s survival. This world depicts a society where people are frustrated about sex and desperate to have children, since all men are infertile.
